title: TaskEnvelope
description: A governed, dispatchable, traceable task envelope. TaskEnvelope is the exchange format for task objects — it is not the Operations state machine itself. Status values are constrained by the Operations specification (IEF-Operations#2).

assignee.description: Agent or runner assigned to this task. May be an agent_id or a runner identifier.

governance_profile.description: Reference to a governance profile defined by IEF-Governance (e.g., 'contract-critical', 'design-lite', 'implementation-controlled'). The profile name must correspond to a profile defined in IEF-Governance#2.

status.description: Current task status. The set of allowed values and transitions is defined by IEF-Operations#2. Protocol only provides the field; Operations owns the state machine.

protocol_version.description: Protocol version this envelope conforms to, e.g., '0.1.0'.

created_at.description: ISO 8601 timestamp when the task envelope was created.

context_refs.description: References to knowledge, context, historical decisions, or external materials. Uses the ContextRef schema.

artifact_refs.description: References to task artifacts (outputs). Uses the ArtifactRef schema.
